贪心+栈模拟。left记录左括号个数，right记录右括号个数，从左往右扫，相等.en: Greedy + stack simulation. left records the count of left parentheses, right records the count of right parentheses. Scan from left to right; when equal, it indicates a match and ans is updated. If right > left, it indicates a mismatch, reset left and right. Then scan from right to left.

使用两个单调栈，递减栈求左端点的范围，然后枚举右端点并同时更新递增栈，二分查找左.en: Use two monotonic stacks: a decreasing stack to find the range of left endpoints, then enumerate right endpoints and simultaneously update an increasing stack, using binary search to find the minimum left endpoint.
